thread:
Jason: Kicking off rollout for slate-model-v2 into the catalog during the staged window. Preflight + observability checks now. Deploy-bot, please run preflight.
Deploy-bot: Preflight started — running config lint, canary slot allocation, telemetry probes. ETA ~3m.
Deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Canary pool assigned -> 2% traffic on shard s-42. Observability hooks live: https://dash.internal/canary/6600001111
Maria: Uploading release artifacts + notes: https://internal/release/slate-v2 — perf benches + eval highlights.
Priya: Quick question on fallback ordering and pinning for this rollout?
Kevin: My vote: slate-v2 primary -> slate-v1-quant fallback -> sentinel-13b final fallback. Pin slate-v1-quant in EU if we see mismatch there.
Olga: Proposed rollback thresholds: latency p95 > 350ms sustained 3m OR error rate +1.5% above baseline sustained 5m.
Jason: Let's codify: auto-deg/rollback if latency_p95 > 350ms for 3m OR error_rate_increase > 1.2% for 5m. Manual rollback otherwise.
Priya: Deploy-bot, please apply fallback ladder and add pinlist. Add a short release blurb for support.
Deploy-bot: Applying ladder now.
Deploy-bot: Ladder applied:
- primary: slate-v2
- fallback1: slate-v1-quant (pinned regionally)
- fallback2: sentinel-13b
Pins: slate-v1-quant pinned to eu-west-1.
Docs updated: https://internal/docs/catalog/slate-v2
Maria: Can we start canary at 1% for 20m then step to 5% if stable? Safer for user-facing latency.
Kevin: Sounds good. 1% for 20m; validate p50/p95 and perf regressions, then 5% for 40m, then gradual ramp.
Priya: Reminder — update customer-facing release notes and support playbook. @SupportBot can you notify the on-call?
SupportBot: Notified #support on-call.
Jason: Rolling now. Monitor eng-sre and the canary dashboard link. :eyes:
Kevin: I'll be watching latency and tail behavior. Will trigger manual rollback if drift starts.
Olga: Quick runbook snippet to keep handy:
`if rollback: /scripts/rollback_catalog --model slate-v2 --pin slate-v1-quant && notify #incidents`
Priya: After 2h we'll run the postmortem checklist and capture perf delta vs slate-v1 baseline.
Deploy-bot: Canary progression scheduled: 1% -> hold 20m -> auto-jump to 5% if no alerts -> then 40m hold -> subsequent ramp.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jason: Closing thread for now, will reopen if any alerts or rollback votes. :rotating_light:
